summary: Fixed by reserving a fixed inline size (--range-col: 26ch, inline-block, nowrap) on .time-off-calendar-range, so calendar-prev/today/next no longer shift when the range label's width changes. Unit suite (1430 tests) passes; no integration suite touches this CSS-only change; e2e/tests/time-off-calendar.spec.ts and e2e/tests/regressions.spec.ts (20 tests) pass under CI=1 on dedicated ports 3100/4100, including the new TC-01-E2E-12 which asserts calendar-today's x position is identical across 11 clicks of calendar-next spanning both the shortest and longest month labels.

levels_run.integration: none touched by diff (CSS + e2e spec only)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: calendar-prev/today/next hold one position across every window a preset can reach
acceptance_criteria.evidence: TC-01-E2E-12 passed: calendar-today.x identical across 11 clicks of calendar-next, labels varied (>=4 distinct values) including March 2027 and September 2026

acceptance_criteria.criterion: range label still shows the same text it shows today, for all three presets
acceptance_criteria.evidence: rangeLabel() logic untouched; only CSS box model changed (display/width/white-space)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: reserved width declared as a custom property in .time-off-calendar block, recorded in spec's DS gaps comment
acceptance_criteria.evidence: apps/web/app/globals.css: --range-col: 26ch declared in .time-off-calendar, comment block updated to record it as the fourth DS gap

acceptance_criteria.criterion: no file under packages/ds and no shared layout file changed
acceptance_criteria.evidence: git diff --stat against packages/ds and apps/web/src/layout is empty

functional_walkthrough: Reviewed the CSS diff: .time-off-calendar-range gains display: inline-block, width: var(--range-col), white-space: nowrap — label box is now fixed-width so gaining/losing characters no longer shifts the sibling controls in the space-between row.
Confirmed PageHeader.tsx and packages/ds are untouched, so no other screen using PageHeader is affected (grep for time-off-calendar-range returns only the CSS rule and the one JSX usage).
Ran the full time-off-calendar e2e file plus regressions.spec.ts to confirm no adjacent calendar behaviour (window switching, filters, overlap checks near the header) regressed.

Verified 26ch (~ the width of the widest label the three presets can produce, e.g. '28 Dec 2026 – 10 Jan 2027' at 25 chars) is wide enough in practice — the e2e assertion measures real rendered boxes under the actual font and passed.
Confirmed review and static_gate stages already passed with no findings, and this QA pass found none additional.
notes: The spec's proposed edge-case text for specs/time-off/01-vacation-calendar.md was not added to the spec by this change, and none of the four acceptance criteria require it — consistent with specs being frozen and edited only deliberately, not as a side effect of a bug fix.
